name: Beefeater 24
production: Botanicals steeped in the spirit in the still for 24 hours
history: 1820 | James Burrough's original Beefeater recipe dates back to this year
1876 | Beefeater produced in London since this year
1958 | Production at Kennington since this year
serve_official: G&T with classic tonic and a grapefruit wheel, or a flavour-forward Martini (Gin Guild)
notes: Tea botanical idea came from Master Distiller Desmond Payne while travelling in Japan (no date given). Official site lists awards incl. ISC Double Gold, SFWSC Gold (undated). Gin Guild names bitter almond/orange peel/dried lemon peel slightly differently from official list.
